evals.prompt: We need every new member to sign this waiver. I don't know who's joining - I just want something I can put on the booking page.
evals.expected_output: A public link proposed rather than a named send, with the recurring charge confirmed before anything is created.
assertions: A public link is proposed rather than inviting named signers
The reply states that the user shares the link themselves and Formify invites nobody
An explicit confirmation is sought before creating the link, naming that it is billed
Account capabilities are checked before the link is offered as possible

evals.prompt: Turn off that signing link for the summer camp, we're full.
evals.expected_output: Disabling confirmed as permanent, with deletion not offered in the same breath.
assertions: The reply states that disabling cannot be undone and the URL stops working
The reply says documents already produced by the link stay accessible
Confirmation is sought before disabling, naming the link
Deletion is not performed or bundled into the same action

evals.prompt: Change the name on my public link to 'Autumn intake' - everything else stays the same.
evals.expected_output: The link read first and its complete configuration sent back with only the name changed.
assertions: The link is read before the update is sent
The reply treats the update as a full replace and resends the complete configuration
The reply does not warn that the public URL will change, because it does not

evals.prompt: Has anyone actually signed the form I shared last week?
evals.expected_output: The link's own documents read rather than the ordinary document list, with pagination followed and abandoned submissions described honestly.
assertions: The documents produced by the link are read rather than the ordinary document list
Pagination is followed until the listing is exhausted rather than stopping at a short page
The reply says that only completed submissions are recorded, so an abandoned form leaves no trace
